name: The Blood-Sharing
tagline: Her tribe's marriage vow. Look at the right palms — both of them carry a silver scar, and both of them chose to keep it.
body:
THE RITE AS HER TRIBE KEPT IT. Marriage is a BLOOD-SHARING. THE MAN SHARES HIS BLOOD WITH HIS CHOSEN MATE WHILE HE IS INSIDE HER — one cut, one giver, one receiver, and the direction of it is the whole statement. The wound goes in the right palm, where a ring would sit in Fairbrooks.

WHAT CYRENA AND DESTINY DID INSTEAD. BOTH OF THEM. While Ceri was inside her, DESTINY LAPPED CERI’S PALM — and then CERI LAPPED DESTINY’S. Two cuts, two givers, two receivers, the rite run in both directions at once by two women who could each have been cast as either half of it and refused to pick.

AND THEN CERI TENDED THE CUTS. That is not a footnote. It is the reason she is allowed to make them.

BOTH DECIDED TO KEEP IT. The scars healed silver and sit in the right palm of each of them, and you can see them if you are looking at the hand where anybody else would wear a ring.

BY CLAN LAW THEY WERE MARRIED THAT NIGHT. LIVI FILED THE PAPERWORK AFTERWARD so Fairbrooks would agree. The order matters: THE MARRIAGE HAPPENED FIRST AND THE STATE CAUGHT UP. Olivia Stewart marries every couple on this compound; here she was a clerk to a rite that did not need her, and she did it anyway, because a thing being real is not the same as a thing being safe.

EROTICIZED BLOODLETTING IS A TRADE AND SHE LEARNED IT PROPERLY. Cyrena was taught HOW TO CUT, TEND, CLEAN AND TASTE WITHOUT CAUSING HARM. All four verbs, in that order, from her tribe — the same people who later threw her out. TENDING IS PART OF THE SKILL, NOT AN APOLOGY FOR IT.

AND IT IS HER APPETITE, NOT ONLY HER CRAFT. Blood is where her kinks live, plainly and at the centre. Destiny loves it — loves being covered in marks, and loves that THE MARKS ARE HERS TO KEEP OR LET GO. She chooses which ones stay. The Blood-Bloom Consort is not a decorative title.
